recipe.name: Bekah's Jumbo Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipe.description: Jumbo chocolate chip cookies, 6-tablespoon scoop. Latest user-supplied formula makes approximately 7-8 jumbo cookies; 18-minute oven bake tested successfully.
recipe.source: Bekah Baking ChatGPT Project, user-supplied finalized Jumbo Chocolate Chip Cookies recipe, 2026-11-22; original base from Butternut Bakery BEST Chocolate Chip Cookies

ingredients.name: Flaky sea salt
ingredients.preparation: optional topping, sprinkled immediately after baking

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt 1/2 cup (112 g) unsalted butter. Allow it to cool slightly before mixing.

In a large mixing bowl, combine 1/2 cup (112 g) melted butter, 1/2 cup (100 g) packed light brown sugar, and 1/3 cup (75 g) granulated cane sugar. Whisk vigorously for 1 minute until smooth and combined.
Add 1 large egg and 2 tsp pure vanilla extract. Whisk until smooth.
Mix in 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp baking powder, and 1/2 tsp fine sea salt. Stir until evenly incorporated.
Fold in 1 1/4 cups (165 g) all-purpose flour. Mix gently until no dry flour remains. Avoid overmixing.
Fold in 1 1/2 cups (240 g) semisweet chocolate chips. Distribute evenly throughout the dough.
Using a 6-tablespoon cookie scoop, portion the dough onto the prepared baking sheet. Leave approximately 3 inches between cookies to allow spreading.
Bake at 350°F for 18 minutes, the baking time previously tested successfully. Look for golden-brown edges, slightly soft centers, and lightly golden tops.
Immediately after removing the cookies from the oven, sprinkle each cookie with a small pinch of flaky sea salt, if desired.
Let cookies rest on the baking sheet for 10 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and allow them to cool completely.

recipe.storage: For selling, allow cookies to cool completely before packaging to prevent condensation and sogginess.
recipe.notes: Prep time: 15 minutes. Scoop size: 6 tablespoons. Yield approximately 7-8 jumbo cookies. Flaky sea salt is an optional garnish, described as a small pinch per cookie. Unlike the earlier unverified draft, do not use six 98 g cookies as this recipe's yield.
